title: Setting the iniBuilds A380 profile's mips to 0 breaks its allocation-group fallback and widens display matching
source: Introduced by ddeb1c8; raised in the PR #125 review; fixed in f877ee3.

expected.what: mips = 0 makes matches_display accept any mip count, so the detector feeds the eight five-mip panel textures into the allocation-group detector with the eight one-mip targets, which then rejects the group as ambiguous. The comment claiming the fallback is unaffected is wrong.

evidence: Both the PFD detector and display_candidate_desc use matches_display, so detection sees sixteen candidates and fails whenever names are unavailable. Finding it needs cross-file reasoning from a ten-line diff. The fix restores mips = 1 and adds a separate panel_mips used only for naming.
